summary: Enhance your skills in User Experience (UX) Design and Usability Testing with our comprehensive course. Learn to create intuitive and user-friendly designs.
lede: UX design and usability testing help product teams turn user needs into clearer, testable digital workflows. For professionals shaping digital products, services, or applications, this training covers planning interviews and task analysis, mapping journeys, building clickable prototypes, reviewing accessibility and usability heuristics, and conducting usability tests. Learners also practise interpreting task measures and System Usability Scale results to prioritize evidence-based improvements.
audienceIntro: This foundation-to-intermediate programme suits professionals who influence digital products, services, workflows, or customer-facing applications and need practical UX design evidence for everyday decisions.
prerequisites: No formal UX qualification is required. You should have basic familiarity with digital products, workplace workflows, or service delivery. A working knowledge of common office applications helps, but coding and programming are not required. You should bring a laptop with browser access for Figma and digital workshop activities. Advanced analytics, AI-assisted research, and accessibility automation receive conceptual and operational coverage rather than technical engineering instruction.
